name: Pre-Season 6 - US Qualifiers
blurb: Six players competing for the two US places in Season 6.
rules:
**Play-offs.** The six players are drawn at random into three best-of-three matches. The winners go to the upper bracket and the losers to the lower bracket.

**Double elimination.** Every match is a best of three. Losing in the upper bracket drops a player to the lower bracket; losing in the lower bracket eliminates them. The play-off winner with the best score (most games won, then fewest lost) goes straight to the Upper Final, and the other two play each other for the second place in it. The Upper Final's loser drops to the Lower Final, against the lower bracket's winner.

**Qualifying.** There is no Grand Final: the winners of the Upper Final and the Lower Final are the two players who represent the US in Season 6.

name: Season 6
rules:
**Round robin.** Players are split into two groups, and each plays every other player in their group once. A match is two games, one base game and one DLC game, and every game counts: a player's points are the games they won. The top two of each group go to the upper bracket of the playoffs, 3rd and 4th go to the lower bracket, and everyone else is eliminated.

**Double elimination.** Each match is a best of three. Losing in the upper bracket drops a player to the lower bracket (blanxz lost Match 1 to NuclearPastaTom, then played Match 6); losing in the lower bracket eliminates them. The Grand Final is between the player who won the upper bracket without losing and the winner of the lower bracket.

name: Season 5
blurb: Six teams of two, in 2v2 co-op.
rules:
**2v2 co-op.** Each team has two players: one plays the base game and the other the DLC, and they keep those roles all season. The board mixes base game (B), DLC (D) and co-op (C) squares, and a co-op square needs both players to complete their part before the team can claim it. Once a team claims a square, the other team can't. A completed row, column or diagonal wins; with no line, the team with the most squares wins.

**Round robin.** Each team plays every other team once, in a single game, and a team's points are the games it won. The top four go on to the playoffs.

**Single elimination.** Each match is a best of three. The semi-finals are 1st against 4th and 2nd against 3rd; the winners play the Grand Final and the losers play for 3rd place.

name: Season 4
rules:
**DLC only.** Every game is played on a Shadow of the Erdtree (DLC) board. A completed row, column or diagonal wins; with no line, the player with the most squares wins.

**Round robin.** The ten players are in one group, and each plays every other player once, in a single game. The top four go on to the playoffs.

**Single elimination.** Each match is a best of three. The semi-finals are 1st against 4th and 2nd against 3rd; the winners play the Final and the losers play for 3rd place.

name: Season 3
blurb: Six teams of two, both players in the base game.
rules:
**2v2.** Each team has two players, both playing the base game on the same board. Once a team claims a square, the other team can't.

**First to 13 points.** A team scores a point per square plus two per completed row, column or diagonal, and a line alone doesn't win: the first team to 13 points does.

**Round robin.** Each team plays every other team once, in a single game. Teams are ranked by their points over the round robin, and the top three go on to the playoffs.

**Playoffs.** Best of three, every game also first to 13 points. 2nd plays 3rd in the semi-final, and the winner plays 1st in the final.

name: Season 2
rules:
**Games.** Every game is a 1v1 lockout on a base game board: once a player claims a square, the other can't. A completed row, column or diagonal wins; if a player can no longer complete a line, the other wins by majority (13 squares). After two hours the player with the most squares wins, and equal squares is a draw.

**Round robin.** Each player plays every other player once, in a single game. The top three go on to the playoffs.

**Playoffs.** Best of three. 2nd plays 3rd in the semi-final, and the winner plays 1st in the final.

name: Season 1
rules:
**Games.** Every game is a 1v1 lockout on a base game board: once a player claims a square, the other can't. Each player claims in their own colour. A completed row, column or diagonal wins; if a player can no longer complete a line, the other wins by majority (13 squares). After two hours the player with the most squares wins, and equal squares is a draw.

**Round robin.** Each player plays every other player once, in a single game. The top four go on to the playoffs.

**Playoffs.** Single elimination, best of three: 1st plays 4th and 2nd plays 3rd in the semi-finals, the winners meet in the final, and the losers play for third place.
